## 1. Event API (extension -> n8n)
One endpoint: POST /webhook/dsa-coach/event
events: problem_started, session_end, submission, reflection, coach_requested

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO problems (slug, title, difficulty, url, topics, patterns, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, derive_patterns($1, $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb), now())
ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE SET
  title = EXCLUDED.title,
  difficulty = EXCLUDED.difficulty,
  url = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.url, ''), problems.url),
  topics = CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length(EXCLUDED.topics) > 0 THEN EXCLUDED.topics ELSE problems.topics END,
  patterns = CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length(EXCLUDED.patterns) > 0 THEN EXCLUDED.patterns ELSE problems.patterns END,
  updated_at = now()
RETURNING *;

SELECT p.id AS pattern_id, p.name AS pattern, p.tier, p.weight, p.recognition_signals, p.common_mistakes,
  COALESCE(s.mastery, s.prior_mastery, 0) AS mastery,
  COALESCE(s.problems_solved, 0) AS problems_solved,
  s.last_practiced, s.next_review,
  CASE WHEN s.last_practiced IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE floor(extract(epoch FROM (now() - s.last_practiced)) / 86400)::int END AS days_since,
  COALESCE(s.next_review <= now(), false) AS review_due
FROM patterns p
LEFT JOIN skills s ON s.pattern_id = p.id AND s.profile_id = $1::uuid
WHERE p.name = ANY($2::text[])
ORDER BY p.weight DESC;

UPDATE sessions
SET ended_at = now(), duration_seconds = $3::int, active_seconds = $4::int
WHERE id = $1::uuid AND profile_id = $2::uuid
RETURNING true AS success, 'session_end'::text AS event, id AS session_id, duration_seconds, active_seconds;

WITH prob AS (
  INSERT INTO problems (slug, title, difficulty, url, topics, patterns, updated_at)
  VALUES ($2, $3, $4, $5, $6::jsonb, derive_patterns($2, $6::jsonb, $7::jsonb), now())
  ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE SET
    url = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.url, ''), problems.url),
    topics = CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length(EXCLUDED.topics) > 0 THEN EXCLUDED.topics ELSE problems.topics END,
    patterns = CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length(EXCLUDED.patterns) > 0 THEN EXCLUDED.patterns ELSE problems.patterns END,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING *
), sess AS (
  SELECT id, started_at FROM sessions WHERE id::text = $8 AND profile_id = $1::uuid
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO attempts (profile_id, problem_id, problem_slug, problem_title, difficulty, session_id, attempt_number,
    started_at, submitted_at, duration_seconds, result, hints_used, solution_viewed, editorial_viewed,
    confidence, error_types, performance, source)
  SELECT $1::uuid, prob.id, prob.slug, prob.title, prob.difficulty,
    (SELECT id FROM sess),
    (SELECT count(*) + 1 FROM attempts a WHERE a.profile_id = $1::uuid AND a.problem_slug = prob.slug),
    COALESCE((SELECT started_at FROM sess), COALESCE($16::timestamptz, now()) - make_interval(secs => $9::int)),
    COALESCE($16::timestamptz, now()), $9::int, $10, $11::int, $12::boolean, $13::boolean,
    $14::int, $15::jsonb,
    CASE WHEN $10 = 'accepted' AND $11::int = 0 AND NOT $12::boolean AND NOT $13::boolean AND COALESCE($14::int, 5) >= 4 THEN 'strong'
         WHEN $10 = 'accepted' THEN 'assisted' ELSE 'failed' END,
    'extension'
  FROM prob
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT ins.*, prob.patterns, 'submission'::text AS _source
FROM ins JOIN prob ON prob.id = ins.problem_id;

WITH upd AS (
  UPDATE attempts SET
    reflection = $5::jsonb,
    confidence = COALESCE($3::int, confidence),
    error_types = CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length($4::jsonb) > 0 THEN $4::jsonb ELSE error_types END,
    performance = CASE
      WHEN result = 'accepted' AND COALESCE(hints_used, 0) = 0 AND NOT COALESCE(solution_viewed, false)
        AND NOT COALESCE(editorial_viewed, false) AND COALESCE($3::int, confidence, 5) >= 4 THEN 'strong'
      WHEN result = 'accepted' THEN 'assisted' ELSE 'failed' END
  WHERE id = $2::uuid AND profile_id = $1::uuid
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT upd.*, pr.patterns, 'reflection'::text AS _source
FROM upd JOIN problems pr ON pr.id = upd.problem_id;

parameters.content:
## Skill engine (shared)
submission / reflection / nightly sync all pass through here.
Mastery is re-derived from the full attempt history (nothing is overwritten).

parameters.query:
WITH pats AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.name FROM patterns p
  WHERE cardinality($2::text[]) = 0 OR p.name = ANY($2::text[])
), hist AS (
  SELECT a.id, a.problem_slug, a.difficulty, a.result, a.hints_used, a.solution_viewed, a.editorial_viewed,
    a.confidence, a.duration_seconds, a.error_types, a.submitted_at, a.source, pr.patterns
  FROM attempts a JOIN problems pr ON pr.id = a.problem_id
  WHERE a.profile_id = $1::uuid
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(pr.patterns) x JOIN pats ON pats.name = x)
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'name', name)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM pats) AS patterns,
  (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(hist) ORDER BY hist.submitted_at), '[]'::jsonb) FROM hist) AS history,
  (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name', p.name, 'prior_mastery', s.prior_mastery, 'review_interval_days', s.review_interval_days)), '[]'::jsonb)
     FROM skills s JOIN patterns p ON p.id = s.pattern_id WHERE s.profile_id = $1::uuid) AS skills,
  $3::jsonb AS attempt,
  $1::text AS profile_id;

WITH pat AS (
  SELECT id FROM patterns WHERE name = $2 AND NOT $19::boolean
), up AS (
  INSERT INTO skills (profile_id, pattern_id, mastery, confidence, problems_solved, easy_solved, medium_solved, hard_solved,
    problems_attempted, avg_time_seconds, hint_rate, failure_rate, last_practiced, next_review, review_interval_days,
    error_profile, updated_at)
  SELECT $1::uuid, pat.id, $3::numeric, $4::numeric, $5::int, $6::int, $7::int, $8::int,
    $9::int, $10::int, $11::numeric, $12::numeric, $13::timestamptz,
    now() + make_interval(days => $14::int), $14::int, $16::jsonb, now()
  FROM pat
  ON CONFLICT (profile_id, pattern_id) DO UPDATE SET
    mastery = EXCLUDED.mastery,
    confidence = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.confidence, skills.confidence),
    problems_solved = EXCLUDED.problems_solved, easy_solved = EXCLUDED.easy_solved,
    medium_solved = EXCLUDED.medium_solved, hard_solved = EXCLUDED.hard_solved,
    problems_attempted = EXCLUDED.problems_attempted, avg_time_seconds = EXCLUDED.avg_time_seconds,
    hint_rate = EXCLUDED.hint_rate, failure_rate = EXCLUDED.failure_rate,
    last_practiced = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_practiced, skills.last_practiced),
    next_review = CASE WHEN $15::boolean THEN EXCLUDED.next_review ELSE COALESCE(skills.next_review, EXCLUDED.next_review) END,
    review_interval_days = CASE WHEN $15::boolean THEN EXCLUDED.review_interval_days ELSE COALESCE(skills.review_interval_days, EXCLUDED.review_interval_days) END,
    error_profile = EXCLUDED.error_profile, updated_at = now()
  RETURNING mastery, confidence, problems_solved, problems_attempted, next_review, review_interval_days
), closed AS (
  UPDATE reviews SET completed_at = now(), result = $18
  WHERE profile_id = $1::uuid AND pattern_id IN (SELECT id FROM pat) AND completed_at IS NULL AND $15::boolean
  RETURNING 1
), rv AS (
  INSERT INTO reviews (profile_id, pattern_id, scheduled_for, result, interval_days)
  SELECT $1::uuid, pat.id, now() + make_interval(days => $14::int), 'pending', $14::int
  FROM pat WHERE $15::boolean
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT $2::text AS pattern, up.mastery, up.confidence, up.problems_solved, up.problems_attempted,
  up.next_review, up.review_interval_days, $17::text AS source
FROM (SELECT 1) d LEFT JOIN up ON true;

WITH names AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    NULLIF($3::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb),
    NULLIF((SELECT patterns FROM problems WHERE slug = $2), '[]'::jsonb),
    derive_patterns($2, $4::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb)
  ) AS arr
)
SELECT (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'pattern', p.name, 'recognition_signals', p.recognition_signals, 'common_mistakes', p.common_mistakes,
      'template', p.template, 'mastery', COALESCE(s.mastery, s.prior_mastery, 0))), '[]'::jsonb)
  FROM patterns p
  LEFT JOIN skills s ON s.pattern_id = p.id AND s.profile_id = $1::uuid
  WHERE p.name IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(arr) FROM names)
) AS patterns;

options.instructions: You are a DSA interview coach. You receive a LeetCode problem, its likely pattern and a hint level. Level 4 = a detailed approach as short numbered steps with the key invariant and complexity, NO code. Level 5 = the complete solution with code and complexity, because the learner explicitly asked for it. Never give more than the level allows. Under 250 words.

parameters.content:
## 2. Daily plan
7 AM email + POST /webhook/dsa-coach/plan (extension can fetch it)
Mode (build/consolidate/mock/taper/restart) -> priority = weight x gap x forgetting -> difficulty controller -> problems from your target sets

parameters.query:
SELECT p.id AS profile_id, $2::text AS via
FROM profiles p
WHERE $1::text = '' OR p.id = NULLIF($1::text, '')::uuid
ORDER BY p.created_at
LIMIT 1;

WITH pf AS (
  SELECT p.*, $2::text AS via FROM profiles p WHERE p.id = $1::uuid
), pats AS (
  SELECT p.name, p.topic, p.tier, p.weight, p.prerequisites, p.recognition_signals,
    COALESCE(s.mastery, 0) AS mastery, s.prior_mastery, s.last_practiced, s.next_review,
    COALESCE(s.problems_attempted, 0) AS attempted, COALESCE(s.problems_solved, 0) AS solved,
    CASE WHEN s.last_practiced IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE floor(extract(epoch FROM (now() - s.last_practiced)) / 86400)::int END AS days_since,
    COALESCE(s.next_review <= now(), false) AS review_due
  FROM patterns p LEFT JOIN skills s ON s.pattern_id = p.id AND s.profile_id = $1::uuid
), cand AS (
  SELECT t.set_name, t.position, t.slug, t.title, t.difficulty, t.patterns, t.url,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM attempts a WHERE a.profile_id = $1::uuid AND a.problem_slug = t.slug) AS tries,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM attempts a WHERE a.profile_id = $1::uuid AND a.problem_slug = t.slug AND a.result = 'accepted') AS accepted_count,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM attempts a WHERE a.profile_id = $1::uuid AND a.problem_slug = t.slug AND a.performance = 'strong') AS strong_count,
    (SELECT max(a.submitted_at) FROM attempts a WHERE a.profile_id = $1::uuid AND a.problem_slug = t.slug) AS last_attempt_at
  FROM target_set_problems t
  WHERE t.set_name = ANY(COALESCE((SELECT target_sets FROM pf), ARRAY['starter']))
)
SELECT
  (SELECT to_jsonb(pf) FROM pf) AS profile,
  (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(pats)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM pats) AS patterns,
  (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (
     SELECT a.difficulty, a.result, a.performance, a.hints_used, a.submitted_at, a.problem_slug, pr.patterns
     FROM attempts a LEFT JOIN problems pr ON pr.id = a.problem_id WHERE a.profile_id = $1::uuid ORDER BY a.submitted_at DESC LIMIT 8) r) AS recent,
  (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(cand)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM cand) AS candidates,
  (SELECT max(submitted_at) FROM attempts WHERE profile_id = $1::uuid) AS last_attempt_at,
  (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(pl)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (
     SELECT plan_date, mode, restart_step FROM plans
     WHERE profile_id = $1::uuid AND plan_date < current_date ORDER BY plan_date DESC LIMIT 4) pl) AS recent_plans,
  extract(dow FROM now())::int AS dow,
  current_date::text AS today;

INSERT INTO plans (profile_id, plan_date, mode, restart_step, total_minutes, message, items, priorities)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::date, $3, $4::int, $5::int, $6, $7::jsonb, $8::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (profile_id, plan_date) DO UPDATE SET
  mode = EXCLUDED.mode, restart_step = EXCLUDED.restart_step, total_minutes = EXCLUDED.total_minutes,
  message = EXCLUDED.message, items = EXCLUDED.items, priorities = EXCLUDED.priorities, created_at = now()
RETURNING id;

## 3. LeetCode sync (3 AM + after cold start)
Imports your recent accepted solves (as 'assisted-unknown' evidence, never as mastery),
then re-derives every skill from history. LeetCode only exposes the last ~20 accepted submissions.

parameters.query:
WITH prob AS (
  INSERT INTO problems (slug, title, difficulty, url, topics, patterns, updated_at)
  VALUES ($2, $3, $4, 'https://leetcode.com/problems/' || $2 || '/', $5::jsonb, derive_patterns($2, $5::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), now())
  ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE SET
    difficulty = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.difficulty, 'Unknown'), problems.difficulty),
    topics = EXCLUDED.topics, updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id, slug, title, difficulty
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO attempts (profile_id, problem_id, problem_slug, problem_title, difficulty, attempt_number,
    started_at, submitted_at, result, hints_used, solution_viewed, editorial_viewed, performance, source)
  SELECT $1::uuid, prob.id, prob.slug, prob.title, prob.difficulty,
    (SELECT count(*) + 1 FROM attempts a WHERE a.profile_id = $1::uuid AND a.problem_slug = prob.slug),
    $6::timestamptz, $6::timestamptz, 'accepted', 0, false, false, 'assisted', 'leetcode_sync'
  FROM prob
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM attempts a
    WHERE a.profile_id = $1::uuid AND a.problem_slug = prob.slug
      AND abs(extract(epoch FROM (a.submitted_at - $6::timestamptz))) < 21600)
  RETURNING id
), pf AS (
  UPDATE profiles SET last_synced_at = now() WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id
)
SELECT prob.slug, (SELECT count(*) FROM ins) AS imported FROM prob;

parameters.content:
## 4. Cold start (already-started students)
POST /webhook/dsa-coach/cold-start with profile + self_ratings per topic (1-5).
Ratings become a weak PRIOR only; real attempts replace it. Then the LeetCode import runs immediately.

parameters.query:
WITH pf AS (
  INSERT INTO profiles (id, name, email, leetcode_username, target_company, target_role, target_date,
    hours_per_week, daily_minutes, level, target_sets)
  VALUES (COALESCE(NULLIF($1::text, '')::uuid, gen_random_uuid()), $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, NULLIF($7::text, '')::date,
    $8::numeric, $9::int, $10, $11::text[])
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
    name = EXCLUDED.name, email = EXCLUDED.email, leetcode_username = EXCLUDED.leetcode_username,
    target_company = EXCLUDED.target_company, target_role = EXCLUDED.target_role, target_date = EXCLUDED.target_date,
    hours_per_week = EXCLUDED.hours_per_week, daily_minutes = EXCLUDED.daily_minutes, level = EXCLUDED.level,
    target_sets = EXCLUDED.target_sets
  RETURNING id
), rt AS (
  SELECT key AS topic, (value #>> '{}')::numeric AS rating,
    LEAST(0.6, ((value #>> '{}')::numeric - 1) / 4 * 0.6) AS prior
  FROM jsonb_each($12::jsonb)
), pri AS (
  INSERT INTO skills (profile_id, pattern_id, mastery, prior_mastery, confidence, problems_attempted)
  SELECT pf.id, p.id, rt.prior, rt.prior, rt.rating, 0
  FROM pf CROSS JOIN patterns p JOIN rt ON regexp_replace(lower(rt.topic), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = regexp_replace(lower(p.topic), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g')
  ON CONFLICT (profile_id, pattern_id) DO UPDATE SET
    prior_mastery = EXCLUDED.prior_mastery,
    mastery = CASE WHEN skills.problems_attempted > 0 THEN skills.mastery ELSE EXCLUDED.mastery END
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT pf.id AS profile_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM pri) AS priors_saved FROM pf;

parameters.query:
WITH pf AS (SELECT * FROM profiles ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1),
wk AS (
  SELECT a.* FROM attempts a JOIN pf ON a.profile_id = pf.id
  WHERE a.submitted_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT to_jsonb(pf) FROM pf) AS profile,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT problem_slug) FROM wk) AS problems,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT problem_slug) FROM wk WHERE performance = 'strong') AS independent,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT problem_slug) FROM wk WHERE performance = 'assisted' AND COALESCE(hints_used, 0) > 0
     AND NOT COALESCE(solution_viewed, false) AND NOT COALESCE(editorial_viewed, false)) AS hint_dependent,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT problem_slug) FROM wk WHERE COALESCE(solution_viewed, false) OR COALESCE(editorial_viewed, false)) AS solution_dependent,
  (SELECT e FROM (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(error_types) AS e FROM wk WHERE jsonb_typeof(error_types) = 'array') x
     GROUP BY e ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS top_error,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT r.pattern_id) FROM reviews r JOIN pf ON r.profile_id = pf.id
     WHERE r.completed_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS patterns_reviewed,
  (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (
     SELECT p.name, p.topic, p.weight, COALESCE(sk.mastery, 0) AS mastery, COALESCE(sk.problems_attempted, 0) AS attempted, sk.last_practiced
     FROM patterns p LEFT JOIN skills sk ON sk.pattern_id = p.id AND sk.profile_id = (SELECT id FROM pf)) s) AS patterns;
